claims.statement: The CLI component in calc_app/cli.py provides a thin wrapper over the Calculator class, handling input through argparse and rendering results to standard output.
The GUI component in calc_app/ui.py uses Tkinter to provide a visual interface that delegates evaluation, formatting, and auxiliary arithmetic operations to the Calculator core.

Both CLI and UI modules maintain a strict separation of concerns by delegating all arithmetic computation, expression validation, and internal state management to the Calculator core, while interfaces focus solely on lifecycle, event handling, and user interaction.
